t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are split into 2 groups, big hats and small hats. They also differ in colour. It is trial and error, continue to pick the gnome that gives you the most luck, e.g big brown gnome. Once that stops giving you the most mushrooms switch to another gnome. You will have lucky colours of gnomes and you need to try and remember them.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes are divided into two groups based on their hat size - big and small. They are then divided by colour (Brown vs Purple, Yellow vs Red, Blue vs Orange and Pink vs Green). Firstly I would pick the small hat gnome. If both are small then pick a colour and alternate until you find the lucky colour. When the colour you have picked, e.g. Purple, stops giving you good luck then switch to the Brown one. I found I had to switch a few times throughout the game. It is very much trial and error / luck based. I found that anything over 10 points was good, but it depends on the x1 / x5 at the beginning. If the colour gnome starts to drop below 10 points switch colour. REMEMBER where you've had good luck with colours and hat sizes, this seemed to be the same throughout the rounds. PS purple is a great colour ;)
